spans.text: Foyer, ground floor of Zeratul-Worcester Pharmaceuticals.
Squad 404 begins a full search.
Looks like we're late.
This place has been cleared out. Only a few worthless items are left.
We should just go straight to the signal's position.
This building used to be pretty fancy, you know.
Just look at these extravagant crystal chandeliers, the well-carved sculptures, the exquisite oil paintings...
It's a shame the place hasn't been cleaned for so long. Now it's all covered in dust.
Hasn't been cleaned? More like "whoever came here doesn't know how to clean".
UMP45 kneels down and carefully examines the clear footprints on the dust-coated marble floor.
Did we...leave these?
Look at the size of these two rows of footprints. We couldn't have made them unless we had two Annas around.
Also, there's a mess of jumbled-together footprints here. Did the local wild dogs get inside?
What if there's something following us...
Don't be stupid!
Well, if we want to find out what it is, we'll just have to catch up to it.
UMP45's gaze follows the footprints to the other end of the foyer.
Let's go. There's no intel in the foyer.
This is all too easy, aren't you worried that it's a trap?
Of course it's a trap, and that's why it's worth investigating.
More importantly, the ones who left these footprints might be old friends of ours.
Huh? Could it be...
Tap tap tap—
A set of hurried footsteps echoes through the empty foyer.
Who...who's there?!
(Shrieks)
Quiet!
Who is it? Come out right now!
They won't show themselves just because you holler at them.
Since the opposition has extended a sincere invitation to us, it would be rude of us not to show up.
416, keep an eye on our two deadweights.
9, follow behind 416 and cover her.
Okie!
You're talking to me like I was some kind of nanny Doll...
Squad 404 cautiously advances to where the sound of the footsteps vanished, and they see a beat-up radio around the corner.
The footprints stop here. Are there no other paths?
Looks like they escaped to another floor via the elevator.
But there are so many floors, which one did they go to...?
According to the floor indicator next to the elevator, everything from the second floor up is the office area, Basements 1 and 2 are parking spaces...
Basement 3 isn't labelled, but it has a button of its own.
Basement 3 looks very suspicious.
That's super ominous...
Anna, why are you spacing out?
I...I feel like I've been here before...
But I can't recall anything...
Looks like we're in the right place, then. Let's go check out Basement 3.
It needs an ID card.
Tsk. Hold on tight.
What? Oh no, not this again...
Wahoo! I haven't felt this in a while!
What are you going to do?
Don't ask! Just hold on tight to 416!
Creakcreakcreak—
The old door slowly grinds shut, then the elevator plunges down like it's out of control...
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!
You're gonna break my legs at this rate!
UMP45! I forbid you to use this trick again!
In the blink of an eye, the elevator comes to a stop on the Basement 3 level.
As the elevator door opens, a pitch-dark abandoned warehouse comes into view.
Is this...an underground warehouse?
This is the first time I've seen a major corporation put a warehouse under their HQ.
Given the scale of this company, something of this size wouldn't be big enough to hold their drugs.
So you're saying...what they stored here were...
Things they couldn't make public.
In TV shows, people who know too much get silenced...
Judging by the scrape marks on the ground, it would seem a lot of cargo has passed through this place. Now, however, all that's left are the remains of empty crates.
Squad 404 spreads out to investigate, seeking to piece the truth together from the fragments.
It's just a mess of empty crates...
The shipping manifests have been shredded, and what's left has been scribbled all over.
All we can do is bring them home and see if we can make sense of them.
Why were they using wooden crates?
If they were only shipping medicines, wouldn't cardboard be enough?
You raise an excellent point.
Anna silently walks up to a crate and gently runs her fingers over the lid which now lies on the ground.
What did you find, Anna?
The insides of the box and its lid are covered in terrifying scratch marks. Each of them is dark brown, etched with pain and despair.
This is...
I...remember now...
I've been here before... I was stored here for some time...
But I don't remember where I came from...
I only remember spending a long time in the darkness, nauseous and suffocating. I was dizzy and bored out of my mind. Then my world finally lit up again...
What...? So these boxes...
...Inside the camera room.
Dreamer studies the monitor showing the warehouse thoughtfully.
She already knows this much despite being an unmodified juvenile?
I've been studying this for so many days without making much headway. To think I'd have a breakthrough right here.
I'm even beginning to like Griffin a little now.
What are we investigating?
You won't remember it in a couple of hours anyway, so why should I tell you?
C'mon, tell me! I know my memory has been deteriorating very quickly...
But...tellmetellmetellmetellme...
Our boss Elisa fired all of Sangvis Ferri, so now we need to find a new boss.
Griffin's so poor they can't even feed themselves, and the Military's pretty much on the verge of collapse.
That leaves Paradeus, who we don't understand at all. So we're going to do our homework and verify their strength.
But I don't like Paradeus' uniforms...
Do you really think you're in any position to be picky?
Then what should we do now?
We snatch that useful girl, of course.
Can't you even remember that after salvaging parts for so many days?
What do you mean by salvaging parts?
But those four are there too...
...You forgot again?
What are you afraid of? Our objective is just to grab that juvenile Nyto. We don't have to fight the others.
So you mean...
After consoling Anna, 416's eye is drawn to a gray-colored object lying in the crate.
Gr G11! How can you even fall asleep inside that crate at a time like this?!
Get out of that at once!
(Whimpers) Don't pinch my face...
Wait a minute, what's that under you, Gr G11?
No wonder it felt so uncomfy...
These are... Doll parts?
They don't look like Griffin-model parts...
As I thought...
Snap—
The lights in the warehouse go out all of a sudden.
Many pairs of crimson eyes glow in the darkness.
